dimensions.evidence: designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in West Haven, Connecticut, as the Captain Paul W. 'Bud' Bucha Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center

dimensions.assessment: The effect is purely administrative and honorific, changing the official name of a building.
dimensions.evidence: designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in West Haven, Connecticut, as the Captain Paul W. 'Bud' Bucha VA Medical Center

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply any federal spending changes or economic costs associated with the renaming.
Limited strictly to a single facility designation and corresponding updates to federal references.
dimensions.evidence: Any reference in any law, regulation, map, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the medical center referred to in subsection (a) shall be considered to be a reference

dimensions.assessment: The name change is permanent for the designated facility.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill performs a specific honorary renaming of a single Department of Veterans Affairs medical center, resulting in negligible broader economic, legal, or systemic effects.
